overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. No quorum of either board attended mediation, notices were sufficiently detailed, and litigation strategy under Purpose 3 was a proper executive session basis.

allegations.summary: Boards allegedly deliberated outside a noticed meeting to agree to participate in mediation with Newport Materials.
allegations.key_passage: The Boards deny that they engaged in any deliberation outside of noticed meetings, and we find no evidence suggesting that there were any discussions outside of noticed meetings.

allegations.summary: Boards allegedly conducted the Newport mediation outside a noticed meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, no quorum of a public body (i.e., no quorum of either board) participated in mediation.

allegations.summary: Meeting notices allegedly did not adequately disclose that the boards would discuss mediation with Newport in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: We conclude that the meeting notices met the requirements of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Boards allegedly discussed mediation in executive session under Purpose 3 when they should have used Purpose 9 after an open-session vote.
allegations.key_passage: Purpose 9 governs executive-session participation in mediation by a quorum of a public body.
